title: Canonical completed coefficient map for finite coefficient extensions
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and finite intermediate fields $E\subseteq F$ of [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set]. For a scheme $T$ and the completed integral coefficient sheaves of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], define the canonical map $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{T,E}\to\widehat{\mathcal O}_{T,F}$ as follows. Transport each finite-dimensional coefficient field to a small model using its canonical algebra equivalence, preserving the fields and their valuation rings of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Conjugate the actual field inclusion by those equivalences, use the valuation-ring inclusion of [lem-weil-integral-scalar-extension-well-defined] and lift it to the prescribed coefficient universe. For each $n\geq0$, its preservation of the $(n+1)$st powers of maximal ideals induces the quotient ring map. Through the recorded constant-section-normalized finite coefficient identifications this gives $c_n:\mathcal O_{T,E,n}\to\mathcal O_{T,F,n}$. The completed map is the unique $c$ with $c\,\pi_{F,n}=\pi_{E,n}\,c_n$ for every $n$. Define its ambient scalar extension to be the K-flat derived tensor functor of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] along this map. The algebraic-closure and scheme universes are independent.

proof.text: Transport membership in the source principal ideal power down through ULift.ringEquiv. Apply WeilConjectures.integralScalar_quotient_kernel from [lem-weil-integral-scalar-extension-well-defined] to the conjugated field inclusion. Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem recovers target ideal membership. Transport the resulting divisibility back through ULift.ringEquiv.symm. This proves pbcIntegerInclusion_ideal for every positive exponent.

For the constant quotient sheaf systems of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower], construct a natural transformation with the quotient inclusions as components using NatTrans.ofOpSequence. Functoriality of constantSheaf reduces consecutive naturality to equality of quotient-ring homomorphisms; extensionality on representatives proves this by reflexivity.

Conjugate this natural transformation by the source and target pbcConstantSystemComparison isomorphisms of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Its components are definitionally pbcFiniteScalarMap. Mathlib Limits.limMap gives the completed map, limMap_π proves all required projection equations, and limit.hom_ext proves uniqueness.
